text: FCLoopPropagatorPowersExpand[exp] rewrites propagators raised to integer powers as products.
SFAD[{q, m, 2}, q + p] ex = FCLoopPropagatorPowersExpand[%]

ex // StandardForm (*FeynAmpDenominator[StandardPropagatorDenominator[Momentum[q, D], 0, -m, {1, 1}], StandardPropagatorDenominator[Momentum[q, D], 0, -m, {1, 1}], StandardPropagatorDenominator[Momentum[p, D] + Momentum[q, D], 0, 0, {1, 1}]]*)
